content: Now the M10 to M30 computer tiers are available for near-instant provisioning. Historically, the free tier in Azure DocumentDB was made available for instant provisioning. The goal was to help you get started without having to wait for 10-15 minutes for clusters to become available. In addition, AI agents don’t have to spend cycles waiting for cluster provisioning before you can kick off a wave of experimentation. Now you and your agents can use the popular M10 tier for basic functional testing and experimentation. You can continue to use the M30 as the staple entry point for production-tier applications as you begin your journey on Azure DocumentDB before scaling to higher clusters tiers as you grow. Learn more.
